question: A, B, C are three angles of a triangle. If A - B = 45° and B - C = 15° then ∠A =?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C are three angles of a triangle.

A - B = 45° and B - C = 15°

Concept used:

All internal angles of a triangle sum up to 180°.

Calculation:

∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180° ....(1)

∠A - ∠B = 45° ....(2)

∠B - ∠C = 15° ....(3)

(1) + (2) + (3),

2∠A + ∠B = 240° ....(4)

Solving (4) and (2), ∠A = 95°

**∴ The measure of ∠A is 95°.**
